name: RIDSTIG Rug, flatwoven, off-white/red, 5 ' 7 "x7 ' 10 "

dimensions.source: IKEA Measurements section, read in Chrome 2026-10-22; feet and inches to inches (5'7" = 67, 7'10" = 94): Width is w, Length is d; no thickness row, so no h

notes: Flags: none. Rejected 2026-10-22: 100 % cotton and the care label says 'Do not wash' (vacuum, shake and rotate only); the staging brief allows a dining rug only if it is a washable flatweave, and Maddie is 4. Otherwise it fit: the brief's 5'7" x 7'10" size, and the page says it is 'Suitable for use underneath your dining table' and 'fits under a 4-seat dining table'. The cheapest 5'7" x 7'10" flatweave seen (TELEGRAFLINJE, the other, is $149.99). 3.6 stars (24). MORUM (ikea-20203563, hand washable) was taken instead.
